yt_summary: Help coding agents use current Go packages, features, and best practices
description: Help AI coding agents write modern Go
purpose: This repository contains guidelines for code agents that help them write modern Go code. For example, an agent with these guidelines uses `max(a, b)` instead of an if-else block, `slices.Contains` instead of a manual loop, `cmp.Or(a, b, c)` instead of a chain of nil checks. It also knows about recent additions like `new(42)` to get a pointer to a value and `errors.AsType[T](err)` for type-safe error matching—both from Go 1.26.
